email.text:
Hi Karen,

I have been looking at the summer swimming lessons at the Riverside Community Centre for our kids. Since your daughter Emma is seven, the best option for her would be {{1}}. The classes are twice a week right after school, so I could drive both girls together, because my Lily is in the same group.

My son Ben just turned twelve, so he would join the {{2}} on Wednesday evenings. It is a bit late, but it only runs for {{3}}, so it will be finished before our trip in August.

I was also thinking of signing up for the {{4}} myself, since I never learned to swim properly. It is the most expensive program at {{5}}, but I think it is worth it.

Let me know what you think.
Sarah

options: To ask Karen to teach swimming
To suggest swimming lessons for their children
She is in the same age group as Emma
She will take lessons on Saturday
